root.description: Absolute native path of the project root. Informational; identity is `id`.

repositories.description: External Git repositories linked in .amaru/repositories.yaml. An entry with `error` is never used. Omitted by the initial Project inspection implementation.

present.description: Whether a regular .amaru/config.yaml blob exists at the inspected HEAD. Dirty working-tree edits are ignored; malformed or unsafe config fails inspection.

path.description: Relative committed config path, .amaru/config.yaml when present.

present.description: True after successful bounded read-only Git inspection. Unavailable or unusable Git fails the operation.

branch.description: Optional inspected branch; omitted by the initial implementation.

remote.description: Optional sanitized origin URL, never contacted. Omitted by the initial implementation; raw remotes are never disclosed.
